title: StateDocument
description: The typed state document (state.json): what a world's game state is and its initial values — score, inventory, quests, flags. A save game is base + state declaration + a player's session log (spec/state.md). Experimental until 1.0 pins it, like the document it describes.

fields.description: The declared fields, keyed by dotted name. A dot-prefix is a namespace by convention (score., quest., inv.); a world's own state SHOULD stay in one namespace.

initial.description: The field's initial value; absent means null (or the empty map, for map fields).
